<!-- One resource per pull request, please. The checks comment on this pull request within a few minutes
     (on a first contribution, once the maintainer has approved the run). -->

**What does this change?**

- [ ] Adds a resource
- [ ] Corrects a resource
- [ ] Archives a resource (say why below)
- [ ] Translation, docs or engine change

**For a new resource**

- [ ] The data or the API can be used today, free of charge (a free account or a free tier counts).
- [ ] `license` names the resource's own licence, and `license_url` links to where it is stated.
- [ ] The URL has no tracking parameters and is the resource's own page.
- [ ] I am affiliated with the publisher: **yes / no**. If yes, the description stays plain, without marketing words.

**Anything the maintainer should know**
